source: A. Grzyb, M. Kowalski, 'Optimisation of five-link suspension mechanism of a vehicle solid tyres', Engineering Transactions 49(1), 47-63, 2001 (IPPT PAN). doi:10.24423/engtrans.573.2001
figures: p.50 Fig.2 (scheme), p.52 point definitions, eqs (3.5),(3.6) p.53, p.57 coordinates (original), p.58 optimized A_i + Fig.3 (steer angle), p.59 Fig.4 (camber)
travel_definition: s = vertical displacement of point B7 [mm], range -100..100, positive up

steer_angle_changed.how_read: digitized from Fig.3 solid line (scanned, slightly skewed), uncertainty +-0.01 deg; s=-100,0,10,100 read by eye

steer_angle_original.how_read: digitized from Fig.3 dashed line where separable from solid; elsewhere coincident with solid within ~0.01 deg; uncertainty +-0.015 deg

camber_changed.how_read: digitized from Fig.4 solid line, uncertainty +-0.05 deg

camber_original.how_read: digitized from Fig.4 dashed line where separable, uncertainty +-0.05 deg

independent_check: Own 5-SS solver with these points reproduces both curves of Figs 3 and 4 (original and changed) within the digitizing uncertainty (camber within ~0.07 deg, steer within ~0.01 deg). gamma(0)=0.859 deg and delta(0)=-0.229 deg follow directly from B6,B7.
